records.title: University of Graz Scholarships for International Students

validation.notes: The shard's official_source_url (https://www.uni-graz.at/en/studies/scholarships) returns HTTP 404, so I escalated up the AGENT_BRIEF section 4 hierarchy to the University's own official communications/press brand page on presse.uni-graz.at, which is an official uni-graz.at subdomain and explicitly publishes the institutional logo. Asset lives on static.uni-graz.at, the University's own asset CDN. Verified HTTP 200 both with and without the ?1790656598 cache-buster query string, Content-Type image/svg+xml, 6625 bytes - so the URL is stable without the query parameter. Not_ui is false only because this is also the live uni-graz.at header logo; it is the University's official brand mark, not browser chrome, a sprite or a favicon. identity_match holds: the record's official_source is 'University of Graz' and this is the University of Graz logo.

records.title: Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program at Sciences Po (Graduate Level)

validation.notes: Asset is on the record's own official_source_url host and is the Sciences Po institutional wordmark (#E6142D), verified HTTP 200 image/svg+xml 3121 bytes. not_ui is false only because it is also the site header/footer logo; it is the official brand mark, not UI chrome. Identity: the official programme page states 'The Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program at Sciences Po is designed for students from the African continent who wish to pursue a two-year Master's degree at Sciences Po' and routes enquiries to info.mcfsp@sciencespo.fr, i.e. Sciences Po administers the programme and is the record's official_source. Confidence is MEDIUM rather than HIGH purely on this point: the Mastercard Foundation is a named funding partner, so a reviewer could argue the programme's own brand is the Mastercard Foundation mark. I deliberately did NOT use a Mastercard Foundation logo, because (a) it is a different organisation than the record's official_source, and (b) the brief forbids 'an unrelated department's logo on a shared CDN' and any mark whose identity is not the record's own provider - a funder's mark would be partner branding, not provider branding. Flagging for HUMAN_REVIEW if the catalogue wants partner marks.

source.raw_extract: The Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program at Sciences Po is designed for students from the African continent who wish to pursue a two-year Master's degree at Sciences Po. The Program covers the full financial needs of selected Scholars and provides comprehensive support throughout their two years of study at Sciences Po. ... For further questions about the Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program at Sciences Po, please contact us: info.mcfsp@sciencespo.fr.

records.title: CLP Future Conservationist Awards 2027

validation.notes: HIGH confidence in the NOT_FOUND determination. The Conservation Leadership Programme does have an official logo, but it exists ONLY as an inline <svg> element embedded directly in the HTML of every page (14 inline <svg> elements per page; zero external .svg src/href references across the homepage, the award page and the About Us page). There is therefore no fetchable asset URL for it. Every logo-like FILE on the official domain is a rejected class: cropped-icon-32x32.png / 192x192 / 180x180 (apple-touch-icon) / 270x270 (msapplication-TileImage) are all favicon/app-icon derivatives. Per the brief, official absence beats fake branding, so image_url stays null rather than substituting a favicon or a partner logo.

rejected.reason: favicon (link rel=icon, 32x32) - low-resolution favicon-sized badge.
favicon variant (link rel=icon 192x192) - app/favicon derivative, not the brand asset.
apple-touch-icon - explicitly rejected by AGENT_BRIEF section 7.
msapplication-TileImage - favicon/app tile derivative.
200x200 favicon-sized badge; on the homepage it is rendered inside a quoteSlider-img avatar slot (class="quoteSlide-img", 120x120), i.e. an avatar/decoration context, not a brand-asset page.

not an asset I could prove official: it is a bare uploads filename with no enclosing official brand/asset page linking it as the programme logo, and no identity metadata. Cannot satisfy the proof requirement.
decorative hero/editorial artwork - not a logo.
third-party vendor logo (hCaptcha) - CAPTCHA UI branding, unrelated organisation.
third-party agency case study mentioning a 'brand refresh of their logo' - an aggregator/mirror, not an official CLP asset source, and no asset URL offered.
partner organisation's (WCS) newsroom press release - third-party mirror of CLP content, and no CLP logo asset served from it.
social media profile - explicitly rejected, and would only ever yield an avatar.

records.notes: Genuine official absence of a fetchable asset, not a research failure. Recoverable only by screenshotting the inline header SVG, which the brief forbids ('screenshot crops or photographs of a logo'). BirdLife International / Fauna & Flora / WCS marks were also considered and rejected: they are partner organisations, not the CLP brand, and are not hosted on the CLP domain.
